# clavis env

<p class="cli-lead">Manage environments</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis env <command>
```

</div>

Each project has environments such as Development, Staging and
Production. Child environments inherit values from their parent and can
override them.

## Examples

```sh
clavis env ls
clavis env diff dev prod
```
